selection_rules.membership_wins: first 40 Classic-bike rows between 60 and 2700 seconds inclusive, in source archive order
selection_rules.pay_per_use_wins: two shortest Classic-bike rows between 300 and 900 seconds inclusive; equal-duration ties use source row order

membership_wins.selection_order: first qualifying rows in source archive order

pay_per_use_wins.selection_order: shortest duration first; equal-duration ties use source row order

transformation.background_rule: fill to 600 rows from valid source trips in source order; background rows are not included in target-user costs
transformation.cost_input_rule: include only rows where scenario_target is true; exclude all background rows
transformation.source_fact_rule: preserve every parsed source-field text value; add only scenario_target
transformation.scenario_overlay_disclosure: All trip rows come from the official archive. Only the scenario_target assignment is synthetic.
transformation.cost_assumptions: Use exact elapsed minutes without rounding each ride; apply unlock and per-minute rates from the captured pricing passages; round only final scenario totals to cents.

target_selection_rule.selection_order: first qualifying rows in source archive order
shortest duration first; equal-duration ties use source row order
